steps.title: Different starting paths. A clear next step.

items.title: Individual care
items.text: Start directly with a diagnostic evaluation (90791), or choose an optional free 10-minute phone consultation or paid 30-minute individual consultation first.

items.title: Couples care
items.text: Begin with a required 30-minute couples consultation, followed by one separate diagnostic evaluation per partner, then return together for 53-minute couples sessions.

items.title: Your 10-minute consultation
items.text: An optional phone introduction for individuals and couples. If an arranged video connection does not work immediately, it becomes a phone call. The caller may show the practice name or a hidden number.

faq.title: Answers before you schedule.

items.question: Do I have to have a consultation before individual therapy?
items.answer: No. Individuals can go directly to the diagnostic evaluation (90791). The free 10-minute phone consultation and paid 30-minute individual consultation are optional. [Compare your starting options](/how-to-start-therapy/#individual-journey).

items.question: What is the first appointment for couples?
items.answer: All couples start with a paid 30-minute couples consultation to align goals and the rhythm of care. An optional 10-minute phone call may come first, but does not replace it. Each partner then has one separate diagnostic evaluation with the couples therapist before joint 53-minute couples sessions. [Read the couples journey](/how-to-start-therapy/#couples-journey).

items.question: Do you offer online therapy?
items.answer: Yes. Secure telehealth may be available to eligible clients who are physically located in Washington at the time of care.

items.question: How do I check insurance benefits?
items.answer: [Email support@mft.care](mailto:support@mft.care?subject=Verify%20my%20therapy%20benefits) to start a benefits-verification request. Coverage depends on the clinician, service, plan, and network status.
